import json, resource, signal, sys, time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from hashlib import sha256
from threading import Event
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import check_constructive_delivery_v34 as d
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (170, 175))
def expired(*unused): raise TimeoutError('original 90-second HTTPS observation deadline')
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, expired)
signal.alarm(90)
started = time.monotonic()
base = d.ROOT / '_deploy/peano-lab'
app = 'releases/a-ea9ae0d7f72a/'
manifest_name = app + 'APP_MANIFEST.sha256'
manifest_raw = d.bounded_source(base / manifest_name, d.MAX_FILE)
manifest_sha = sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest()
assert manifest_sha == 'ea9ae0d7f72a9c7e5098a2c2ef56d6b114e8801a859ad2e5a9aaa07f68df49e4'
manifest = {}
for line in manifest_raw.decode('ascii').splitlines():
    digest, name = line.split('  ', 1)
    assert name not in manifest
    manifest[name] = digest
assert len(manifest) == 608
names = ['index.html', manifest_name, app+'worker.js', app+'py/peano_lab/ui/data_library.py', app+'py/peano_lab/library/editions_v34.py', app+'py/peano_lab/library/linear_congruence_classification_candidate.py', app+'proof-artifacts/linear-congruence-classification-proof-bundle-v1.json', app+'proof-artifacts/prime-field-polynomial-gcd-bezout-proof-bundle-v1.json']
def snapshot():
    result = {}
    for name in names:
        raw = d.bounded_source(base / name, d.MAX_FILE)
        pin = {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
        if name.startswith(app) and name != manifest_name:
            assert pin['sha256'] == manifest[name[len(app):]]
        result[name] = pin
    assert result['index.html']['sha256'] == 'a05d5520e6acdefa391dc5be5f0556355a687668f467e9579360b6acafb1e752'
    assert result[manifest_name]['sha256'] == manifest_sha
    return result
before = snapshot()
binding = d.source_binding()
stop = Event()
executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4)
futures = []
requests = []
try:
    futures = [executor.submit(d.fetch, {'stage_relative_path': name, 'https_path': '/peano-lab-next/'+name}, before[name], manifest_sha, started+85, stop) for name in names]
    for future in futures:
        requests.append(future.result(timeout=max(.001, started+90-time.monotonic())))
finally:
    if len(requests) != len(names): stop.set()
    for future in futures: future.cancel()
    executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
after = snapshot()
assert before == after and binding == d.source_binding()
seconds = time.monotonic() - started
passed = len(requests) == 8 and all(row['passed'] for row in requests) and seconds < 90
report = {'schema': 'peano-v34-preview-https-observations-v1', 'proof_authority': False, 'stage_authority': False, 'production_promotion_authority': False, 'application_manifest_sha256': manifest_sha, 'source_binding': binding, 'local_before': before, 'local_after': after, 'requests': requests, 'request_count': len(requests), 'passed': passed, 'seconds': seconds, 'limits': {'workers': 4, 'request_seconds': 20, 'whole_window_seconds': 90, 'cleanup_seconds': 5, 'file_bytes': d.MAX_FILE}}
signal.alarm(0)
print(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if passed else 1)
PY
